correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact 4-term reduced graph-chain model and all 48 automorphisms. Boundary squared to zero; ranks (363,1033,540) mod 32003 become exact Q ranks using connectedness, last-column bound and published Ko–Park H1 theorem. Direct 48-action on the 8-dimensional H1 quotient fixes its character, while an independently enumerated 9704-state full-chain alternating trace verifies Euler data for all 48 symmetries. Rational irreducible character inner products are nonnegative integers with summed dimensions 8 and 47. Topology claims limited to Q and cellular quotient.

value.rationale: Three-body motion on the octahedron is a natural canonical nonplanar-symmetry test case: degree-two rational topology is 47-dimensional, and its full octahedral module and quotient invariants cannot be recovered from general Betti or generator theorems. The 48-element character and eigenspace/quotient consequences specify meaningful behavior of graph symmetries on interacting particle loops and 2-cycles.
